# 2026-05-21 - Pay Schedule Setup

## Summary

Added a Pay Schedule Setup page for creating company pay schedules.

## Changes

- Added `/setup/pay-schedules`.
- Added company selection.
- Added pay schedule creation for Weekly, Biweekly, Semimonthly, and Monthly frequencies.
- Added date validation and active status entry.
- Added calculated next pay period preview.
- Added navigation link for Pay Schedules.
- Added user, admin, support, and technical documentation.

## Cautions

- ClearPath Payroll provides software tools for payroll calculation, reporting, and data transmission. It does not provide legal, tax, financial, accounting, or payroll compliance advice. Users are responsible for verifying payroll, tax, filing, payment, and compliance requirements with qualified professionals or official agency sources.
- Confirm pay schedule dates before processing payroll.
- Do not enter sensitive payroll, tax, ACH, banking, or API secret data in schedule names.
